title: Weighted Frames and the Douglas-Foias problem
summary: Let $\mathbf{T}=(T_1,\ldots,T_n)$ be a commuting tuple of bounded linear operators on a separable Hilbert space $\mathcal{K}$, and let $\{a_α\}_{α\in\mathbb{Z}_+^n}$ be strictly positive weights. Under mild assumptions on the weights, we characterize the weighted frame vectors and weighted Parseval frame vectors, that is, those vectors $ξ$ for which $\{a_α\mathbf{T}^αξ\}_{α\in\mathbb{Z}_+^n}$ is a frame or a Parseval frame. We reduce the problem to characterizing surjective module maps from the reproducing analytic Hilbert module associated with the weights onto the module $\mathcal{K}$,…
